project.name: EIR :: gl
project.description:
Journal construction and the GL boundary: balanced postings per contract (FR-802, invariant SL-2) and the sub-ledger to control-account reconciliation (FR-803, invariant SL-1). The engine POSTS to a general ledger; it is not one, per 08's scope table.
Framework-free, and it takes no exemption under ADR-0010. That is worth stating because "GL adapter" sounds like the module where a framework would arrive: an adapter that speaks to a real GL needs transport, and transport needs a library. It does not live here. This module produces the postings as values; carrying them anywhere is eir-batch's problem, and eir-batch is the module ADR-0010's exemption mechanism exists for.
Depends on eir-domain only. Journals are built from balances and amounts, not from projections or solves — nothing here needs eir-calc, and depending on it would make the ledger boundary look like part of the calculation path.
